name: wingman-broker-intent-classifier
description: Classifies a broker email body into one of {offer, bid, counter, quarterly, spot}. Trained on a curated synthetic corpus that matches the linguistic shape of real broker comms (FOB/CFR jargon, validity clauses, counterparty cues). Re-train on real anonymised samples in production for higher accuracy.

example: 25kt propane FOB Houston for Aug-15 indication 610 vs USGC mean - 2 firm by EOD
